Containers.Name: AppdataCleanupNG
Containers.Description: A modernized revival of Squid's (Andrew Zawadzki) CA Cleanup Appdata, brought up to date for current Unraid (6.4+/7.x) where the original no longer runs. Finds appdata folders left behind by removed Docker containers and lets you review their sizes and delete the ones you no longer need. Note!: Deletion is permanent - always review the folders the plugin offers before deleting. Deletes are confined to the appdata share and never cross a mount boundary. Beta: orphan detection, delete-safety, and install are verified on current Unraid; custom appdata pools, ZFS dataset deletion, and Docker Compose coverage still need real-world testing - reports welcome in the support thread. Getting Started: after installing, open Settings -> Cleanup Appdata.
